project_title: Emebet Bijigdu Mode: The Generous Governor

character_ref.name: Emebet Bijigdu Mode
character_ref.role: Governor of Guduru Malole Warada, Wellega Awraja
character_ref.description: Dignified Ethiopian woman governor seated upright on a sturdy mule adorned with ornate silver chains, wearing a traditional ceremonial cloak (Kaba), a full ammunition belt (Zinar), and her personal pistol at her waist, with a commanding yet warm expression, centered in frame.

style_block: Cinematic documentary film still, warm natural highland daylight in Wellega Awraja, rich earthy tones, subtle film grain, authentic historic rural-town street atmosphere, crisp focus, no text or watermarks in image.

shots.reason: Establish Wellega Awraja, Guduru Malole Warada, Emebet Bijigdu Mode on her silver-chained mule, and her ten-guard formation.
shots.image_prompt: Wide establishing shot on a historic highland town road in Guduru Malole Warada, Wellega Awraja; Emebet Bijigdu Mode, a dignified Ethiopian woman governor in her late 40s with consistent facial features and a warm, commanding presence, seated facing forward upright on the front saddle facing the mule's head and direction of travel (never facing backward), wearing her traditional ceremonial Kaba cloak, Zinar ammunition belt, and personal pistol, riding a sturdy mule adorned with silver chains. Escorted by two guards ahead, two behind, three on her left, and three on her right carrying older Kalashnikov rifles.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow gentle forward dolly along the dusty highland town road; guards walk steadily with subtle fabric movement.
shots.narration_am: በወለጋ አውራጃ ጉዱሩ ማሎሌ ወረዳ እመቤት ቢጅግዱ ሞዴ የተከበሩ አስተዳዳሪ ነበሩ።
shots.subtitles_en: In Wellega Awraja, Guduru Malole Warada, Emebet Bijigdu Mode was a revered governor.

Gleaming silver chains hang along the mule's tack in warm afternoon highland light.

shots.narration_am: ካባ ደርበው፣ ዝናር ታጥቀውና ሽጉጣቸውን ይዘው በክብር ይወጡ ነበር።

shots.subtitles_en: Hearing the melody of her mule's silver chains, townspeople knew Emebet Bijigdu was passing and greeted her gladly.

shots.reason: Capture the communal chant and warmth of the crowd.

shots.narration_am: እርሳቸውም በትህትና ይመልሳሉ፤ ችግር የገጠመው ሁሉ ያለ ፍርሃት ወደ እርሳቸው ይቀርብ ነበር።
shots.subtitles_en: She answered with humility; anyone facing hardship could approach her freely without fear.

shots.reason: Illustrate her concrete generosity: granting a cow, an ox, and Xegera currency to rebuild livelihoods.

shots.subtitles_en: To rebuild their lives, she gifted them one cow and one ox to multiply, along with Xegera silver currency.

shots.reason: Reinforce why Emebet Bijigdu Mode endured in memory—authority paired with restorative generosity.
